output.span: a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges. UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 261(1): prepayment charge not permitted.
output.reason: The evidence supports that, under para 261(1), a UCB must not levy pre-payment charges on all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, and the provided case tags indicate floating rate, non-business purpose, and an individual borrower. However, the evidence does not mention a specific “3%” foreclosure (pre-closure) charge or equate that “foreclosure/pre-closure” fee with “pre-payment charges,” so the claim about a 3% foreclosure charge is not fully supported.
